lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Denise Smith is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Denise is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Denise Smith is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Denise kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Denise's gone." Rocco looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Denise." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Debbie blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Denise Smith, 41 days. The mantle passes to Debbie Rothstein.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Debbie Rothstein, 37 — a Midwife. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Beard Moss, Green Thumb, Literally, Cornucopia.
d41: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Gardener of the Living Garden." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Denise — and Denise is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Shannon, Rocco, Mohand and 6 more speak for Debbie — "Denise trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Debbie before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d57: 🕯️ Debbie's funeral feast: 1,500 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Emberhold. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
d57: DEBBIE — GONE. 3 open questions closed unanswered.
d57: 🕯️ Debbie Rothstein is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.

d57: ★ The record corrects itself: this was never Wild Carrot — it's Mayapple. someone taught you wrong (their own memory). (The Codex marks the disagreement. You can call them out in conversation.)
d57: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d57: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d57: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
d57: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d57: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d57: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
